title: Red Hat Security Advisory: php8.4 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A critical security update for PHP 8.4 addresses multiple vulnerabilities including out-of-bounds reads and writes, use-after-free conditions, double free, request smuggling, cross-site scripting (XSS), signature bypass, information disclosure, remote code execution, local privilege escalation, and denial of service. These issues affect PHP components such as PHP-CGI, PHP-FPM, SOAP, session handling, and PHAR OpenSSL signature verification. The update is provided by Red Hat for their Enterprise Linux 10.2 Extended Update Support and related variants.
